b3/firmware/Makefile.note: the host twins' build (twin, record-twin, wire-twin, wire-parity) into the top-level ignored build/; not the image build.

b3/firmware/b2_search.c.note: B2's engine and its two operators, unchanged (E1): the R and F arms run it through b2_search_init; the O arm through b3_online_init (b3_online_view.c), never b2_search_init.

b3/firmware/b3_carto.c.note: the specimen cartographer, the C twin of b3/host/b3_carto.py (image stage 1).

b3/firmware/b3_carto_twin.c.note: the cartographer's host driver (b3/tests/test_b3_carto_twin.py); never linked into the image.

b3/firmware/b3_online_view.c.note: the O arm's initializer and online view (image stage 2).

b3/firmware/b3_record.c.note: the O arm's combined commitment, ledger entry and record block (image stage 2).

b3/firmware/b3_record_twin.c.note: the O arm's host driver (b3/tests/test_b3_record_twin.py); never linked into the image.

b3/firmware/b3_wire.c.note: DERIVED from B2's wire unit: app_identity 1.6.0 (carto_version, arms, b1_map_cost in their sorted positions), loop_record 1.4.0 (the pre-rendered search block — B2's renderer's on R / F, b3_record_json's on O — embedded as given), and the outer arm refused unless it is random_safe | map_guided | online. Everything else is B2's byte for byte (b3/tests/test_b3_wire_contract.py, the B2 parity). It must exist and must DIFFER from the base.

b3/firmware/b3_wire.h.note: DERIVED from B2's wire header: the identity's three B3 fields, the B3_WIRE_ARM_* names, B3_WIRE_ARMS and B3_WIRE_B1_MAP_COST, the 1.4.0 comments and the include guard. It must exist and must DIFFER from the base.

b3/firmware/b3_wire_parity.c.note: the B2 / B3 wire parity driver, compiled against both wire units (b3/tests/test_b3_wire_contract.py); never linked into the image.

b3/firmware/b3_wire_twin.c.note: the wire's host driver (b3/tests/test_b3_wire_contract.py); never linked into the image.

b3/firmware/p3_data.h.note: B2's generated data header (host/gen_b2_data.py): the B1 self-map compiled as B2 compiled it — B2_MAP_INIT for the F arm's column view only, B2_MAP_LUT / B2_MAP_INIT for the universe mask — the train / holdout vectors, the seed exclusion.

b3/firmware/p3_derive.c.note: the instrument's derive unit (sha256, CRC-32, the genome codec), as B2 imported it from the instrument (firmware/b2/IMPORT.json, kind=verbatim).

b3/firmware/p3_derive.h.note: the instrument's derive header, as B2 imported it.

scope: the CURRENT image-source surface of b3/firmware at image stage 3 — every file under it but this table, each classified verbatim (a byte-for-byte copy of a B2 file), derived (a B2 file changed as its note says, base and derived digests recorded) or new (B3's own, no base). It is NOT yet the final image import inventory: the application / build stage adds every remaining docs/b3_architecture.md §7 (E1) item — the instrument's p3_rectx / p3_pull, the BSP and the linker script verbatim, the application derived — and the image itself. The pin table has not been generated, so this table is extended in place until it is.
